definition: why some ways of working install in a single read and others I fight and never keep

settled:
Some fit my grain closely enough to go in whole on one reading. Others I argue with the whole way through and never stick with.

I keep finding frameworks already shaped like something I am and bolting them on. The Done Manifesto. Getting Things Done and the importance-against-urgency grid. Mana, borrowed off a game to name my executive function as a bar that drains. The harness words, which arrived long after the harness and described twenty years of it cleanly.

What makes one fit is that it already matches a shape I have. Adopting it is recognition rather than building, which is why it costs almost nothing to install and why it holds.

A single read is the tell. Something that needs ten readings is fighting my grain. Something that rewrites what I do in one had nothing to fight.

This is not the same move as building a definition for a human thing I cannot feel my way into. That manufactures what was missing. This names what was already there.
